method.basic: k copies of the card + filler (with 2 Lumber cards) vs 20 filler, a random day/night and field per game; seeds 7700 + 131g
method.advanced: same test deck vs 5 cards from the top 40% pool + the rest from every measured card (min(4, rarity copy limit) copies, top-rank caps), drawn per game
method.count: a game counts only if the test side played the card at least once (winRate / advRate over played games; winRateAll over all games)

seconds.note: two segments (the first advanced pass, 20 top-40% cards, stopped at 59 cards and was replaced by the mix); report re-fitted with --report-only
